newsitem.title: UK: Dlr/mark steady near lows, guilder falls vs mark.
newsitem.headline: Dlr/mark steady near lows, guilder falls vs mark.

text.p: 1050 GMT - Dlr/mark bobbing around session lows, dollar/yen steady. Mark/guilder at strongest since Aug 93, fanning talk of hike in Dutch special advance rate from 3 pct. Stg/mark holds below 3.0 but cable clambers back above $1.63. US Q2 employment cost index at 1230GMT, July consumer confidence at 1400GMT. Fed's Rivlin testifies at 1400GMT.
